Python Developer.description: Develops backend systems and applications using the Python programming language.
Python Developer.responsibilities: Design scalable systems, write clean code, optimize performance, collaborate with teams.
Python Developer.expected_outcomes: Deliver optimized backend services, integrate APIs, and ensure scalability.

Frontend Developer.description: Builds the user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) of web applications.
Frontend Developer.responsibilities: Develop responsive UIs, optimize web performance, collaborate with designers, consume APIs.
Frontend Developer.expected_outcomes: Deliver fast, accessible, and responsive user interfaces that match design specifications.

Backend Developer.description: Develops server-side logic, APIs, and database interactions for web applications.
Backend Developer.responsibilities: Build and maintain APIs, manage databases, ensure security and scalability, handle business logic.
Backend Developer.expected_outcomes: Deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance APIs and backend systems.

DevOps Engineer.description: Manages infrastructure, automation, and deployment pipelines to bridge development and operations.
DevOps Engineer.responsibilities: Build CI/CD pipelines, manage cloud infrastructure, ensure reliability (SRE), automate deployments.
DevOps Engineer.expected_outcomes: Create a stable, automated infrastructure; enable fast and reliable deployments; improve system reliability.

Data Scientist.description: Analyzes complex data to find insights and builds machine learning models to make predictions.
Data Scientist.responsibilities: Perform EDA, build predictive models, communicate insights to stakeholders, design A/B tests.
Data Scientist.expected_outcomes: Deliver actionable insights from data and build accurate predictive models that drive business value.

MLOps Engineer.description: Manages the lifecycle of machine learning models, from deployment to monitoring and retraining.
MLOps Engineer.responsibilities: Build ML pipelines, deploy models, monitor for drift, manage infrastructure for ML.
MLOps Engineer.expected_outcomes: Build and maintain a robust, automated platform for the entire ML model lifecycle.

QA/Test Engineer.description: Ensures software quality by designing and executing manual and automated tests.
QA/Test Engineer.responsibilities: Write test plans, create test cases, report bugs, develop automation scripts, perform regression testing.
QA/Test Engineer.expected_outcomes: Identify and document defects, ensure high software quality, and increase test coverage through automation.

System Architect.description: Designs the high-level structure and standards for complex software and IT systems.
System Architect.responsibilities: Define technical vision, make high-level design choices, manage technical debt, mentor teams.
System Architect.expected_outcomes: Produce a clear, scalable, and maintainable system architecture that meets all business requirements.

Cloud Engineer.description: Designs, builds, and manages an organization's cloud infrastructure (e.g., on AWS, GCP, Azure).
Cloud Engineer.responsibilities: Provision cloud resources, manage networks and security, automate infrastructure, optimize costs.
Cloud Engineer.expected_outcomes: Deliver a secure, scalable, and cost-optimized cloud infrastructure.

Full Stack Developer.description: Works on both frontend and backend technologies to build complete web applications.
Full Stack Developer.responsibilities: Build full-stack features, create responsive UIs, implement APIs, manage databases.
Full Stack Developer.expected_outcomes: Deliver complete, end-to-end user features, from the UI to the database.
